svg.aria-label: Night view from right up against the screen of a Southern porch: a laptop, a phone and a steaming coffee mug on a wooden desk, Edison string lights along the screen frame, a USC flag hanging from the header, a small home server with a blinking network switch on the floor, a gym bag, weight plates and a dumbbell on the floorboards, a cat asleep on the railing, and beyond the screen a palmetto, a crescent moon over the ocean and Charleston's Ravenel Bridge lit up on the horizon.
